messages:
nina_support: Escalating to CS: NovaRetail (trial) reporting persistent 500s + timeouts on embeddings during onboarding import. Customer says this blocks demo and integration tests. Marked P1.

nina_support: Repro: bulk upload ~3k docs via sync endpoint, saw errors after ~2 minutes. Error sample: `HTTP 500 {"error":"internal_server_error"}`. No deploys in last 24h.

omar_cs: Thanks for flag. Primary contact is cam@novaretail.com, trial ends 2026-06-01. This is a high-risk for conversion. We should offer a temporary quota bump + run a quick bridge.

lina_csm: Agreed. Please prepare short comms: apology, workaround, ETA for fix, and offer a follow-up check-in. I can lead the customer call if eng can join.

devin_eng: I see OOM signs in the logs and router backpressure traces. Likely KV cache eviction under heavy concurrent prefixes. Quick mitigation: lower worker concurrency and batch size, or apply a tenant-specific memory cap if safe. Can validate in 3h.

infra-bot: autoscaler: no recent scale events. cluster embed-pool memory utilization spiked 2026-05-15T14:02Z.

nina_support: Proposed immediate customer note: "We're investigating degraded embedding performance. Temporary steps: reduce concurrency to 2 and batch_size to 64; we can also enable a one-time quota increase so your import completes. Engineering will provide an RCA within 48 hours." Approve?

lina_csm: Approve. Add: schedule 30-min bridge within 4 hours and attach a short runbook for their devs. I'll draft email now.

omar_cs: Action items: (1) send customer note + runbook (lina_csm) due 30m, (2) eng validate mitigation in staging + recommend runtime knob (devin_eng) due 3h, (3) temporary quota bump if needed (nina_support/infra) immediate, (4) RCA in 48h (devin_eng).

devin_eng: Starting staging repro now. If KV pressure is confirmed, I'll stage `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` for canary and test behavior.

infra-bot: action: applied tenant_quota=250 to tenant=novaretail at 2026-05-15T14:12Z (temporary 24h) by nina_support.

nina_support: Update: after quota bump and guidance to reduce concurrency, NovaRetail completed 85% of their import and paused retries. Customer asked for assurance before demo; scheduled follow-up 2026-05-16 10:00 PT.

lina_csm: Great. I'll log renewal risk and offer a one-week trial extension if they request. Please post brief RCA here once ready so I can attach to the account notes.

devin_eng: Staging canary reproduces memory pressure; `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` reduced OOMs by ~90% in tests. Planning controlled prod canary next 12-24h.

omar_cs: Thanks team. Keep updates short in this thread; I'll send the customer update after the bridge.
